text:
alex: Quick release-train check-in:
- Done: merged PR #4321 (optimize-batching)
- Blockers: flaky integration/auth-timeout in CI; backport for #4287 still needs approval
- Today: finish cherrypicks + monitor canary

sam: pushed a backport PR: #4330 -> release/1.4. Needs review from @maya.

maya: I can review this afternoon. Heads up: migration script in #4330 changes a DB default — we need a rollback plan.

julian: CI dashboard: https://ci/redwood-inference/job/rel-1.4/987 — failing test integration/auth-timeout (timed out twice). Retrying now.

ci-bot: Build #987 retriggered by @julian — status: running.

sam: cherry-pick commands I used:
```
git checkout release/1.4
git cherry-pick -x 6a2f9b0
git push origin release/1.4
```

alex: Request: keep cutoff at 17:00 PST today; any cherrypicks after that require triage + release lead sign-off.

maya: ack. @julian can you try the flaky test on a different runner?

julian: reran on macos-runner-2 — still flaky. I'll open a tiny skip/timeout tweak in #4332 and ping for quick review.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout group-2: healthy, 0 errors in last 1h. Canary group-1 had a short 502 spike ~14:05 but recovered.

alex: If canary stays green by 16:30 I'll start the full train. Anyone object? :eyes: 

sam: No objections from my side. :+1: 

maya: LGTM pending explicit rollback note in #4330.

julian: will review #4330 and #4332 by 15:30 PT and report back.

alex: Thanks — I'll post final go/no-go at 16:30 PST.
